name: Florida FHSAA State Cross Country Championships
headline: Florida FHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 5 Belen Jesuit won the Class 3A boys title with 26 points, 136 ahead of runner-up Fort Myers (162), and DyeStat's No. 1 boy Marcelo Mantecon won the race in 15:04.8. Nease took the 4A boys title with 80 points over Columbus (145) as East Ridge's Axel Sallault won in 15:18.4. In the girls' big-school races, Bishop Kenny won 3A (62) over Bishop Moore (86), whose Annabella Tomasic won in 17:32.2, and Niceville won 4A (103) over Spanish River (152) behind individual champion Natalia Gaona-Zelaya of Wiregrass Ranch in 17:35.2.
